name: FLOWSTACK Colors system
purpose: Generate and inspect deterministic color candidates without assigning component semantics or hiding changes to brand colors.

rules.statement: Treat Colors output as a candidate until a person approves it and Theme maps and validates its exact values.
Preserve exact source colors by default; adapt only under an explicit bounded policy and report the perceptual change.
Make accessibility claims only for exact measured foreground and background pairs.
Do not infer accent, danger, warning, success, or information meaning merely from hue.
Keep Colors out of React and the application browser runtime; exchange serializable artifacts with Theme.
Keep conversion and gamut mapping separate and report the method and perceptual change whenever a color is mapped.
Do not claim contrast or perceptual difference for a translucent color without an explicit backdrop.
